products.name: Intune Wi-Fi Profile Remediation — Changes Not Applying (Proxy, SSID & Meraki) — Commercial
products.short_description: You edited an Intune Wi-Fi profile — new password, proxy, or SSID — it shows Succeeded, and the devices are still on the old settings. A symptom-driven playbook + 5 scripts that isolate the cause (in-place SSID, proxy placement, duplicates, Cisco Meraki) and prove the fix on the device. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Your Wi-Fi change says “Succeeded” — but the devices never changed

You changed a password, added a proxy, or corrected an SSID in an Intune Wi-Fi configuration profile. Intune reports Succeeded everywhere. Yet the devices keep connecting with the old settings, the old proxy, or the old saved network — and re-pushing, syncing, and rebooting change nothing. It almost never failed: Intune does not reliably overwrite a Wi-Fi network a device has already joined, so the payload is delivered (hence “Succeeded”) while the live network is never rewritten. This package turns that maddening loop into a precise, repeatable diagnosis and a reliable fix.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on an open meter for an active Wi-Fi incident. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — a Step-0-plus-branches decision tree (A–F) with full navigation paths; every object you create is named (WIFIDX - WiFi - Corrected - <platform> - Pilot) and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; comparable consulting runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every future Wi-Fi change.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) whose pass/fail gates prove the change applied on a previously-joined device, not merely that Intune reported it.

The three hard problems it solves head-on

  • In-place SSID won’t update — why an edited profile doesn’t reflect on devices that already knew the network, and the reliable remediation: a new replacement profile and a controlled remove-and-re-add, not an in-place edit.
  • Proxy in the wrong shape — exactly where the proxy lives per platform (Windows / iOS / Android) and the #1 mistake: a URL or host/path in the manual field (which is host + port, never a URL) or a bare hostname in the automatic field (which is a full PAC URL).
  • Cisco Meraki overriding it — how to tell whether the Meraki dashboard (the wireless/SSID side) or Meraki Systems Manager (Meraki’s own MDM, which pushes a competing Wi-Fi payload) is authoritative — and the one-MDM-per-Apple-device test that resolves it fast.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how a Wi-Fi change travels to the saved network, why an in-place edit stalls, and how Meraki fits.
  • Requirements Guide — roles, Graph read access, per-platform device access, the certificate dependency, and the Meraki footprint, each with how to verify.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — Step 0 plus labelled branches (in-place SSID, proxy placement, duplicates/conflicts, Meraki authority, reported-vs-applied, platform quirks) with exact checks and fixes.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — preflight; export Wi-Fi profiles + assignments + proxy with duplicate/conflict detection; on-device Windows applied-state validation; reported-vs-applied reconciliation; and a guarded (-WhatIf) remediation helper — all cloud-aware for Commercial and US Gov (-Environment USGov/USGovDoD).
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides whose gates prove the fix on a real device, plus Best Practices to stop it recurring.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each engagement feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook on the next Wi-Fi change and the next project, across unlimited devices.

The bottom line

The exact reason your Wi-Fi change isn’t reflecting — isolated to one cause — and a repeatable, low-risk pattern to fix it and prove it applied, on Windows, iOS, and Android.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as a single downloadable bundle you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Complete Solution Package (ZIP) — contains:
    • Implementation Guide (PDF & Word) — the complete, click-by-click solution: overview, requirements, the Step-0 + branches diagnostic playbook, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
    • PowerShell Scripts — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only by default; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
      • WIFIDX-Preflight.ps1 — verify the Graph SDK, sign-in, scopes, and cloud environment
      • WIFIDX-Get-WifiProfiles.ps1 — export Wi-Fi profiles + assignments + proxy and flag duplicates/conflicts
      • WIFIDX-Validate-Device.ps1 — read the live saved network + effective proxy on a Windows device
      • WIFIDX-Report-ProfileState.ps1 — reconcile reported (Succeeded) vs applied state per device
      • WIFIDX-Remediation.ps1 — guarded helper to build the corrected replacement profile / clear the stale saved network

Delivered as a Word document and PDF plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
